done

- **Job 1:** I found two bugs and fixed both. The test suite passes now apart from `tests/test_utils`, which you said to ignore.
  - In `src/click/core.py`, the option name was taken from the shortest declaration (`-t`) instead of the longest (`--times`). I reversed the sort.
  - In `src/click/formatting.py`, `measure_table` used `min` where it needed `max`. That broke the help text column layout.
- **Job 2:** I added `click.Duration` in `src/click/types.py`, exported from `click`, and put the tests in `tests/test_types/test_Duration.py`. I also updated `docs/parameter-types.md`, `docs/api.md` and the unreleased section of `CHANGES.md`.
- **Job 3:** `Parameter`, `Option`, `Argument` and `_check_iter` (a helper only they use) now live in `src/click/params.py`. I updated the imports in `__init__`, `decorators`, `shell_completion`, `parser`, `exceptions` and `types`.
  - `core.py` has a lazy module `__getattr__` that serves `from click.core import Parameter, Option, Argument`. This avoids a circular import and keeps all three import paths pointing at the same classes.
  - Inside `core.py`, the few runtime `isinstance` checks against `Argument` and `Option` now import `click.params` lazily.

The suite was green after each job. After job 3 it showed 2076 passed, 24 skipped, 1 xfailed. No linters were installed, so I checked unused and undefined names with a small AST script rather than ruff.
